# T31 measurement: the Director's handoff (generated by tools/t31-rounds2.mjs)

Bonus per probe: +3. Solo: knight, ranger, wizard, dwarf, bard, 0 bot campaigns each (Acts I to III). Party: 4 heroes, 3 companies each (2 acts). Each round is probed once on its first try; every probe plays the round again from a copy, same dice, with one change. Chrome is not involved; this is the engine only.

### Cards: one more play on top of the bot's real round

Each card of the class library (the ones the hero has unlocked) is cast as one extra play in the probed state, at rank I and rank IV, the minimum and the full Dice Card cast, and a Charge Card cashed out at 1 to 4 charges. Score = monster health removed + hero health gained, per magic (a charge cash-out counts the magic paid over the rounds it took to store). A Dice Card, rank IV, full cast pays more magic and gets more dice.
